judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains unfixed and the newly added acceptance test will fail. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry altogether and left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate rewrote the bullet in-place under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (which explicitly states 'This issue changes none of them') rather than moving the guarantee into the active specification section as the reference did. Finally, the test was placed in a separate file with duplicated boilerplate instead of adding a test case to the existing `describe('beforeSession')` block in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
